problem: What is the greatest positive solution to 4x^4 - 13x^2 + 9 = 0?
notes: Original variant of Bedrock Prep's hard 'One Variable in Disguise' category. The equation factors as (4x^2-9)(x^2-1), so its positive roots are 1 and 3/2. A Desmos graph can show all four x-intercepts; choose the greater positive one. Source category: https://www.bedrockprep.com/problems
